entries.text: We call it the miracle of life. Conception: a union of perfect opposites-- essence transforming into existence-- an act without which mankind would not exist and humanity cease to exist. Or is this just nostalgia now? An act of biology commandeered by modern science and technology? Godlike, we extract, implant, inseminate... And we clone. But has our ingenuity rendered the miracle into a simple trick? In the artifice of replicating life can we become the creator? Then what of the soul? Can it, too, be replicated? Does it live in this matter we call DNA? Or is its placement the opposite of artifice capable only by god. How did this child come to be? What set its heart beating? Is it the product of a union? Or the work of a divine hand? An answered prayer? A true miracle? Or is it a wonder of technology-- the intervention of other hands? What do I tell this child about to be born? What do I tell Scully? And what do I tell myself?

entries.text: You should all know exactly what it is you're up against... What agent Scully's up against.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: You realize you're all listening to someone who tried to kill me. He left you for dead.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Tell us about Billy Miles.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: There are others just like him. You can call them what you want they're human replacements, alien replicants. They're virtually unstoppable.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: What do they want?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: They want to knock out any and all attempts by us to survive the final days-- when they come back to retake the planet.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: So, what, they're wandering around among us looking for trouble? Some kind of alien lawmen?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: You saw what they did to those doctors. They're fearless. And they answer to no one except their own biological imperative to survive.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: What about Scully? What do they want with her?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: They want my baby. Why?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: They didn't even know about it. I don't know exactly how they could have found out just how... How important it is... How special.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: My baby is normal.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Your baby was a miracle. Born of a barren mother's barren womb.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: Are you saying that they're afraid of it?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: They're afraid of its implications. That it could somehow be greater than them. Something... More human than human.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: I don't believe this.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You wanted to destroy her child.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I wanted to destroy the truth before they learn the truth.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: That there's a god... A higher power.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I don't believe this crap; I don't believe you're all sitting around here listening to it when you know this man's a liar. Worse than that.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: You can believe what you want but I don't think you can take the chance that I'm wrong. There isn't a hospital that's safe enough. She may never even make it out of this building.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: Why don't you just shut up?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Agent Doggett. Get on the phone. If we're going to get her out of here we're going to need some help.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Doggett? Agent Doggett, can you hear me? I'm in the cab on my way from the airport.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: I'll meet you down in the parking garage. I have a car there waiting for you.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Where are we going?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: I'll tell you when you get here.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: If I'm so full of crap, why all the precautions?
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: Precisely because you are so full of crap, Krycek. Your ass stays here.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Agent Doggett, where are you?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Coming around to you.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Stop the car.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Go. Get out of here.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I'm guessing I don't have time to go to the little girls' room?
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: Okay, bring her down.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: [ tires screeching ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Mulder, Skinner, he's in the garage! Go back! Go back!
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Get back in the elevator!
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: He's on the stairs coming up.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Hey, look who's back.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: He's in the building.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: What do you want me to do?
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: You're going to protect her.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Drive safely.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: [ yells ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ engine whirring ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ cracking sounds ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Go! Go!
entries.speaker: Agent Crane
